description: Ticked one whole song, said thirty-five, and kept the newest lines out of the play-book.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Gave the health without a number of years, and stacked the inn's trestles.
name: John Heminges

description: Showed the watchet, said the voice still held, and agreed not to decorate.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Said the third time had held, and told you not to argue with the holiday.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Claimed the faces and the song, and lifted the trestle.
name: Will Kemp

description: Accepted the spoken tally, forbade a copying, and would not answer the yard.
name: William Shakespeare
